Elena (People Ops): Quick policy check 11 Kai had to change a flight due to a last-minute client meeting. Airline charged a change fee + fare difference on his personal card. He booked through our travel portal but used personal card as preferred. Are change fees reimbursable?
Kai: Yep 11 I moved the ticket from 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-13. Airline charged $75 change fee + $120 fare difference. I attached the booking ref and receipt. I couldn't use the company card because it was declined for that fare class.
Travel Concierge: Policy summary: involuntary / company-requested changes are reimbursable. If the employee voluntarily changes for personal reasons, not reimbursable. For company-initiated changes (meeting reschedule, client request) we reimburse change fee + fare diff. Need evidence (calendar invite or manager note).
Finance Ops: Also: if ticket was booked on company travel card but employee paid change fee personally, reimburse with receipt + transaction on card/account. If booked personally but travel was required by company, reimburse as travel expense. For fare differences, confirm original ticket cost and new ticket cost to compute delta.
Marta (Manager): I asked Kai to move the flight because the client meeting slid by 24h. I can confirm 11 happy to sign off.
Elena (People Ops): Great 11 two administrative things: (1) ask Kai to attach the airline change receipt (showing fee & fare diff) AND the original booking confirmation, (2) add a one-line manager approval comment in the expense thread: "Manager approval: Meeting moved by client, manager Marta approves reimbursement."
Kai: Got it. Quick edge-case 11 the portal shows a $0 credit when I opened a change request and told me to call the airline; then agent charged the $75 fee when reissuing. Will the phone receipt count?
Travel Concierge: Yes: agent phone receipts or email confirmations are acceptable if they show payment breakdown + booking ref. If agent-provided receipt lacks card last4, attach the bank/credit card transaction screenshot that matches date+amount (redact PAN).
Finance Ops: Expense coding: use travel:airfare-change for the fee and travel:airfare for the fare difference. If employee received any airline credit or voucher, deduct that amount from reimbursable total and attach voucher screenshot.
Expense Bot: Reminder: accepted file types JPG/PNG/PDF. Filenames should include date, e.g., 2026-04-10-airline-change-receipt.pdf. Redact full card numbers.
Elena (People Ops): Also note for future bookings: please prefer company card on file when pricing allows. If card fails during checkout, screenshot the error and include brief note explaining why personal card was used. That helps approvals.
Marta (Manager): Ill post the approval now: "Manager approval: client rescheduled meeting; reimbursement ok for fee + fare diff. - Marta"
Kai: Uploaded receipts, bank txn screenshot, and manager note. Thanks everyone.
Elena (People Ops): I'll add a short template for approvers to paste into expense threads and update the travel wiki: "Reimbursable: airline change fees and fare differences when change is company-initiated. Attach airline change receipt (agent email ok), original booking, and manager approval. Deduct any airline credit/voucher. Redact card numbers." :white_check_mark:
